answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 153 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the terrace. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the dune queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. The wander index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 19 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
